-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies OAuth credentials and connectivity.

list-messages.name: list-messages
list-messages.description: List email messages from inbox or specific labels. Supports filtering by unread, starred, etc.

params.maxResults: Maximum number of messages to return (default: 10, max: 100)

get-message.name: get-message
get-message.description: Get full details of a specific email message by ID.

params.messageId: The ID of the message to retrieve

send-message.name: send-message
send-message.description: Send an email message from the specified account.

params.subject: Email subject
params.bodyFile: Path to a file to use as email body (.html/.htm → HTML, .md/.markdown → Markdown auto-converted to HTML, .txt → plain text). Use instead of body to avoid passing large content as a string.

reply-message.name: reply-message
reply-message.description: Reply to an existing email message.

params.messageId: The ID of the message to reply to

search-messages.name: search-messages
search-messages.description: Search for email messages using Gmail's search syntax.

modify-labels.name: modify-labels
modify-labels.description: Add or remove labels from a message (e.g., mark as read/unread, archive, star).

params.messageId: The ID of the message to modify

list-drafts.name: list-drafts
list-drafts.description: List all draft emails in the account.

params.maxResults: Maximum number of drafts to return (default: 10, max: 100)

params.subject: Email subject
params.bodyFile: Path to a file to use as email body (.html/.htm → HTML, .md/.markdown → Markdown auto-converted to HTML, .txt → plain text). Use instead of body to avoid passing large content as a string.

delete-draft.name: delete-draft
delete-draft.description: Delete a draft email by its draft ID.

params.draftId: The ID of the draft to delete

update-draft.name: update-draft
update-draft.description: Update an existing draft email by replacing its content.

params.draftId: The ID of the draft to update
params.subject: Email subject
params.bodyFile: Path to a file to use as email body (.html/.htm → HTML, .md/.markdown → Markdown auto-converted to HTML, .txt → plain text). Use instead of body to avoid passing large content as a string.

get-attachment.name: get-attachment
get-attachment.description: Get the content of an email attachment by its attachment ID.

params.messageId: The ID of the message containing the attachment
params.attachmentId: The ID of the attachment to retrieve

store-attachment.name: store-attachment
store-attachment.description: Download and store an email attachment to the local filesystem.

params.messageId: The ID of the message containing the attachment
params.attachmentId: The ID of the attachment to store

list-labels.name: list-labels
list-labels.description: List all Gmail labels (both system and custom labels) for the account.

update-label.name: update-label
update-label.description: Update an existing Gmail label (name, colors, visibility).

params.labelId: ID of the label to update
params.name: New name for the label

delete-label.name: delete-label
delete-label.description: Delete a Gmail label. This does NOT delete the emails with this label.

params.labelId: ID of the label to delete

list-filters.name: list-filters
list-filters.description: List all Gmail filters for the account.

create-filter.name: create-filter
create-filter.description: Create a new Gmail filter to automatically organize emails.

params.action: Actions to perform when filter matches

delete-filter.name: delete-filter
delete-filter.description: Delete a Gmail filter by its ID.

params.filterId: ID of the filter to delete

start-email-watcher.name: start-email-watcher
start-email-watcher.description: Start a background polling loop that detects new unread emails and emits `gmail.email.received` events to the backend. The watcher polls the Gmail API at a configurable interval (default: 5 minutes). Only one watcher can be active per MCA process.

params.intervalMinutes: Polling interval in minutes (default: 5, minimum: 1). Lower values consume more Gmail API quota.

stop-email-watcher.name: stop-email-watcher
stop-email-watcher.description: Stop the background email polling loop. No more events will be emitted.

get-watcher-status.name: get-watcher-status
get-watcher-status.description: Get the current status of the email watcher: whether it is active, when it last checked, how many message IDs are tracked, and the polling interval.

name: Gmail
description: Gmail email management - send, read, search, label, and filter emails via Google Gmail API

changelog.notes: Initial release — send, read, search and reply to emails, manage drafts, labels, filters, attachments, and watch for new mail
